1. Introduction
Welcome to FarmForward. By downloading, accessing, or using this mobile application, you agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions.
If you do not agree with any part of these Terms, please stop using the app immediately.

FarmForward is a crop management system designed to help users monitor farm activities, track crop stages, and estimate yields.

2. Definitions
For clarity in these Terms, the following words have the meanings given:
• “App” — FarmForward mobile application.
• “User” — any person who installs, accesses, or uses the app.
• “Personal Information” — data such as name, email, location, or any identifying information.
• “Farm Data” — crop information such as soil type, planting date, irrigation level, and farm characteristics.

3. Eligibility
To use this app, you must be at least 13 years old, provide accurate information, and use the app for lawful purposes.

4. User Account
Certain features require name, email, and location. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account.

5. Permissions Required
FarmForward may request access to Location (for region identification), Storage, and Internet Access.

6. Use of the Application
You agree to use the app only for agricultural purposes and input accurate data. You must not reverse-engineer or misuse the app.

7. No Professional Guarantee
The app does NOT guarantee actual crop yields and does NOT replace professional agronomists. It is a supplementary decision tool only.

8. Intellectual Property
All components (name, logo, algorithms) are the exclusive property of the Developers.

9. Data Handling & Privacy
Your use is governed by our Privacy Policy. Personal data may be collected and stored locally or in the cloud.

10. Limitation of Liability
The Developers are not liable for inaccurate predictions, data loss, or technical issues. You use the app at your own risk.

11. Modifications
We reserve the right to modify features or these Terms at any time.

12. Governing Law
These Terms shall be governed by the laws of the Philippines.

13. Contact Information
For inquiries, please go to the contact section.

1. Introduction
FarmForward is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains what data we collect and how we use it.

2. Information We Collect
Personal Information: Full Name, Email Address, Location Information.
Farm Data: Crop type, Soil type, Planting date, Irrigation level, Farm characteristics.

3. How We Use Your Information
We use data to create your profile, calculate yield predictions, determine growth stages, and improve app accuracy.

4. How We Store Your Information
Personal info may be stored in the app’s secure database. Farm data is stored locally or in the cloud (if syncing is enabled).

5. Data Sharing
We do NOT sell, rent, or trade personal information. We only share if required by law or with your explicit permission.

6. Location Data
Used to identify your farm’s region and improve yield prediction accuracy.

7. Data Security
We implement safeguards including encrypted communication and secure database handling.

8. Children\'s Privacy
FarmForward is not intended for children under 13.

9. Your Rights
You have the right to access, update, or delete your data, and withdraw location permissions.

10. Changes
We may update this policy from time to time.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

1. What is FarmForward?
FarmForward is a crop management app that helps farmers monitor crop growth and estimate yield using basic farm information.

2. Do I need an internet connection?
Most features work offline. However, cloud-sync features may require a connection.

3. How do I add a crop?
Go to the Dashboard, tap Add Crop, and enter details like crop type, soil type, and planting date.

4. Why is my predicted yield changing?
Yield predictions update whenever you modify details like soil type, irrigation, or planting density.

5. Why is my stage not updating?
Ensure the planting date is correct. Stages update automatically as days progress based on the crop variety.

6. Who do I contact for help?
Please refer to the Contact Details section in the app.
